Settings.EnableByDefaultHint: Automatically start automating NPC turns when combat begins.
Settings.ActionDelayHint: Milliseconds to wait between individual actions in a turn.
Settings.AttackDelayHint: Milliseconds to wait between individual attacks in a multiattack.
Settings.AutoEndTurnHint: Automatically advance combat after the NPC finishes its turn.
Settings.EnableMovementHint: Allow NPCs to move toward targets before attacking.
Settings.EnableChatLogHint: Post styled chat messages describing NPC actions.
Settings.PreferMeleeHint: Use melee attacks when a target is within melee range.
Settings.PreferRangedHint: Use ranged attacks when target is far away.
Settings.IgnoreUnconsciousHint: Do not target unconscious or defeated tokens.
Settings.IgnoreHiddenHint: Do not target tokens that are hidden.
Settings.MaxMovementHint: Maximum distance the NPC will move toward a target.
Settings.PauseOnErrorHint: Pause combat if an automation error occurs.
Settings.LethalConfirmHint: Ask GM to confirm before an attack that could be lethal.
Settings.MaxActionsPerTurnHint: Hard cap on actions per turn to prevent infinite loops.
Settings.VerboseLoggingHint: Deprecated — use Pathfinding Debug Level instead.
Settings.PathfindingDebugLevelHint: Controls the verbosity of NPC movement diagnostics in the browser console. Off = silent. Minimal = key decisions (target, route, budget, result). Verbose = adds candidate cells, LOS, rejection reasons, replanning triggers. Trace = full per-cell scoring, heading persistence, route comparisons.
Settings.DrawMovementPathHint: Draw a temporary line showing planned NPC movement.
Settings.EnableDashHint: Allow NPCs to Dash when they cannot reach or improve toward their target with normal movement. NPCs with bonus-action Dash can use one bonus-action Dash and, if needed, one action Dash.
Settings.MaxAutomatedCRHint: NPCs above this CR will not be automated.
Settings.NpcOpenDoorsHint: Allow automated NPCs to open unlocked doors that block their path to a target. Each door is only opened once per turn. Doors that are locked or out of reach are ignored.
Settings.EnablePursuit: Pursue Targets That Break Line of Sight
Settings.EnablePursuitHint: When an NPC loses sight of its target, it advances toward the last position where the target was visible. Disable for simpler, less aggressive NPC behaviour.
Settings.NaturalMovementHint: NPCs plan farther ahead around walls while still spending exact D&D 5e grid movement one step at a time.
Settings.MovementStepDelayHint: Controls how long the automation waits per grid step. Higher is slower and gives token rotation/animation helpers time to react. Set to 0 for instant movement.
Settings.FaceMovementHint: Rotate NPC tokens as they move. If Face Target is enabled, final facing points at the target instead of only the next square.
Settings.FaceTargetHint: After movement finishes, rotate the NPC to face its selected target. Recommended when token art should look aimed at the creature it is attacking.
Settings.RotationOffsetHint: Degrees added to the calculated facing. Use 180 if tokens look backwards, 90/270 if they look sideways. This accounts for token art orientation.
Settings.EnableFrightenedRetreatHint: When an automated NPC has the Frightened condition, invert normal behavior: it moves away from player characters instead of attacking.
Settings.EnableBloodiedRetreatHint: Allow NPCs with a retreat subtype or actor-level retreat flag to flee from player characters when they are bloodied at half HP or lower.
Settings.RetreatSubtypeKeywordsHint: Comma-separated behavior subtype words that trigger bloodied retreat, such as coward, skittish, fearful, prey, survivalist. These match the actor behavior tag or D&D type/subtype text.
Settings.EnableBehaviorAIHint: Activates the INT/WIS/archetype-driven behavior engine. NPCs evaluate morale, battlefield conditions, and creature archetypes to make believable tactical decisions. Disable for pure rules-based automation.
Settings.EnableMoraleHint: Track NPC morale across a combat encounter. NPCs may flee or fight more boldly based on ally deaths, outnumbering, and battlefield conditions. Undead and constructs are immune.
Settings.BehaviorAISpellcasterFocusHint: NPCs with high Intelligence (14+) and the tactician archetype will preferentially target enemy spellcasters and healers.
Settings.BehaviorAIPackTacticsHint: Pack-hunter and hive-minded archetypes coordinate attacks on the same target when allies are nearby.
Settings.BehaviorAIOpportunismHint: Predator, opportunist, and assassin archetypes gain a bonus toward wounded, low-HP targets.
Settings.MovementImperfectionHint: Low-INT creatures move directly at targets, crowd against walls, and fail to reroute. High-INT creatures navigate tactically. Archetype overrides (zombie, berserker, assassin etc.) further shape movement personality regardless of stats.
Settings.PassThroughFallenHint: When enabled, NPCs can move through spaces occupied by dead or prone tokens (costs +5ft of movement). Mindless undead and brawlers step over fallen creatures; disciplined soldiers avoid it.
Settings.DifficultTerrainHint: When enabled, NPCs treat difficult terrain as costing double movement (5e RAW). Requires a compatible terrain module (Foundry v12 native terrain, Terrain Layer, or Levels Automatic Cover). If no terrain module is active this setting has no effect.
Settings.KiteRequiresDisengageHint: When enabled, skirmisher archetypes will only kite (retreat after attacking) if the NPC has a bonus-action Disengage feature such as Cunning Action. Without it, kiting provokes opportunity attacks from every adjacent enemy (5e RAW). Disable to allow all skirmishers to kite regardless.
Settings.DispositionTargetingHint: Expands targeting beyond HOSTILE↔FRIENDLY. NEUTRAL tokens attack both sides. SECRET tokens attack everyone. Neutrals retaliate against whoever last damaged them. Disable for legacy v1 targeting.
Settings.EnableElevationHint: Flying and burrowing NPCs adjust their elevation each turn and track vertical distance to targets. Requires tokens to have a nonzero fly or burrow speed. Elevation changes consume movement at 1 ft per 1 ft.
Settings.EnableEffectOverridesHint: When active, NPCs react to charm, confusion, and other behavioral spell effects. Charmed NPCs move toward their charmer but do not attack. Confused NPCs roll on the PHB d10 confusion table. Requires compatible Active Effect flags for non-condition spells.
Settings.EnableMidiSpellsHint: Deprecated in v1.0 — spell AI now runs in all worlds without midi-qol. This setting is ignored.
Settings.SpellOverAttackCRHint: Deprecated in v1.0 — replaced by archetype and cognitive profile system. This setting is ignored.
Settings.SpellEnabledHint: NPCs evaluate their spells and features each turn and use the best one. Works without midi-qol installed; midi-qol improves automation fidelity when present.
Settings.SpellFriendlyFireHint: When enabled, NPCs will cast AOE spells even if allied tokens are in the blast radius. Disabled by default — NPCs won't fire Fireballs through their allies.
Settings.SpellMinAOETargetsHint: NPCs won't cast AOE spells unless at least this many enemy tokens are confirmed to be in the blast radius. Set to 1 to allow single-target AOE.
Settings.SpellSlotConservationHint: Controls how aggressively NPCs spend high-level slots. 'Archetype' uses per-archetype settings (blaster=none, controller=moderate, warpriest=strong). Override to apply the same policy to all NPCs.
Settings.SpellDebugScoringHint: Prints a full spell score table to the browser console each turn. Useful for tuning NPC spellcasting behaviour. Client-side setting.
Settings.EnableAiInference: Run AI Inference on Token Placement
Settings.EnableAiInferenceHint: When a token is placed on the canvas, automatically analyse its actor (creature type, features, weapons, name) and cache an AI profile. This profile drives archetype selection each turn without any manual setup.
Settings.EnableReactionsHint: NPCs use reaction abilities between turns. Supports: Shield (triggers on incoming attack), Counterspell (triggers on enemy spellcast within 60 ft), and damage-triggered reactions such as Hellish Rebuke. Requires midi-qol; if midi-qol is absent this setting has no effect.
Settings.EnforceOneLevelledSpell: One levelled spell per turn (2014 rule)
Settings.EnforceOneLevelledSpellHint: Enforce the 2014 rule that a creature casting a spell with a spell slot may only cast a cantrip with its other action that turn — never two slot-spending spells in one turn. Harmless on 2024 stat blocks (which omit slots). Turn off for homebrew or 2024 monsters that should cast freely.
Settings.EnableConditionBehaviorsHint: Master switch for the expanded condition/spell behaviour layer (frightened, restrained, Command, Dominate, Slow, Blinded, turn-suppression). Off → only the legacy charm/confusion/incapacitated handling applies.
Settings.CondSuppressTurnHint: Unconscious, petrified, stunned, paralyzed, or asleep NPCs take no action or movement.
Settings.CondFrightenedRawHint: Frightened NPCs may still act and attack, but won't move toward the fear source and prefer to keep distance — instead of always fully retreating.
Settings.CondRestrainedHint: Restrained or grappled NPCs (speed 0) attack from their current square instead of trying to path.
Settings.CondCommandHint: Honour the Command spell's one-word orders (Approach, Flee, Halt, Grovel, Drop) and Compelled Duel (must attack the duelist) for one turn.
Settings.CondDominationHint: A dominated NPC attacks its former allies instead of the party (Dominate Person/Monster). Distinct from charm, which only prevents attacking the charmer.
Settings.CondSlowHint: Slowed NPCs lose multiattack (one attack only), take no bonus action or reaction, and move at half speed.
Settings.CondBlindedHint: Blinded NPCs only acquire targets within 5 ft (adjacent), reflecting that they can't see distant foes.
Settings.CondBanishmentHint: A banished NPC takes no turn at all while it's away on another plane.
Settings.CondHasteHint: Hasted NPCs take one additional weapon attack each turn (the Haste extra action), on top of their normal action.
Settings.CondSanctuaryHint: NPCs strongly prefer to attack someone other than a target protected by Sanctuary (which would force a Wisdom save to even target them). They'll still attack a warded target if it's the only option.
Settings.CondSilenceHint: Inside a Silence zone, NPCs skip verbal spells and fall back to weapons. Inside an Antimagic Field, NPCs cast no spells at all. Detected via applied effects or by standing inside the matching template.
Settings.EnableMidiSpellsHintExt: Deprecated — spell AI is now always active. This setting is ignored.
Settings.SpellOverAttackCrHint: Deprecated — replaced by archetype and cognitive profile system.
Settings.EnableBonusActionsHint: After its main action, an NPC spends a bonus action if it has one available (off-hand attack, Healing Word, self-buff, etc.). Beneficial bonus spells route to allies/self via disposition; bonus heals only fire when someone is hurt. Off → NPCs never take bonus actions (pre-0.17 behaviour).
Settings.EnableLegendaryActionsHint: Legendary NPCs spend legendary actions at the end of other combatants' turns (one option per trigger, RAW). Costs are read from the item ('Costs N Actions'), the pool refreshes at the start of the creature's own turn, and decisions are recorded in the AI trace. Off → legendary actions are never automated.
Settings.EnableLairActionsHint: Creatures with lair actions act at the top of each round (initiative 20). Discrete lair-action items are executed automatically; a single grouped 'Lair Actions' descriptor instead whispers the GM a reminder to resolve it. Off → lair actions are never triggered.
Settings.LegendaryBannerHint: Show a brief animated banner across the screen when a legendary or lair action fires, so the table notices the boss acting outside its turn. Off → chat message only.
Settings.SnapshotIncludeResourcesHint: The pre-block snapshot also captures spell slots, item charges, and the set of active effects, restoring them on undo (effects gained during the block are removed; effects that expired stay expired). Off → undo restores positions and HP only (pre-0.18 behaviour).
Settings.EnableFlankingMovementHint: Pack archetypes (pack-flanker, pack-hunter) and strong focus-fire NPCs try to reach the melee cell opposite an engaged ally before falling back to the nearest one. Off by default — not all tables use the optional flanking rule, and the movement pattern reads as flanking even without the mechanical advantage.
Settings.EnableSwimClimbSpeedHint: NPCs standing in water-tagged regions or tiles budget movement from their swim speed; creatures whose climb speed exceeds their walk use it when hugging walls. Off → all movement budgets use walking speed (pre-0.18 behaviour).
Settings.PathfindSingleFloodHint: Compute one reachability flood to the largest needed budget and derive the normal/dash/double-dash tiers by filtering, instead of up to three separate floods per turn. Pure optimisation — decisions are identical; turn this off only when diagnosing pathfinding issues.
Settings.PathfindSmartPartialHint: When no attack position is reachable this turn, the fallback cell weighs threat exposure alongside distance, and tie-breaks on line of sight (ranged NPCs keep it, stranded melee breaks it) — instead of blindly picking the geometrically closest cell.
Settings.PathfindLosMemoHint: Memoise wall-collision sightline tests for the duration of each automated turn (invalidated on any wall/door change). Significant speed-up on wall-dense maps; identical results.
Settings.TargetPersistenceHint: NPCs prefer to keep attacking last turn's target (decaying bonus over 2–3 turns) instead of ping-ponging between equidistant enemies. Always overridden by: target dropped, priority-target flag, forced targets (charm/taunt), or a clearly better candidate.
Settings.TargetGrudgeMemoryHint: NPCs track who has damaged them this combat. Attackers gain a capped targeting bonus proportional to damage dealt, and a single hit over 25% max HP registers as a morale shock.
Settings.SharedTargetMemoryHint: When a target hides, every NPC that saw it records the last known position. NPCs with INT 10+ can use positions reported by allies (they shout); dim creatures only remember what they personally saw. Entries expire after 3 rounds or on re-sighting.
Settings.EnableOpportunityAttacksHint: Automated NPCs take opportunity attacks when a hostile token leaves their melee reach without Disengaging (one reaction per round, skipped if midi-qol's own OA handling is detected). OFF by default: this interrupts player actions — playtest before enabling.
Settings.RetargetOnKillHint: When a multiattack drops its target mid-sequence, remaining attacks retarget the best valid enemy already within reach from the current position (no extra movement) instead of being wasted.
Settings.AoeThreatMemoryHint: Recently-placed damage templates (Spirit Guardians, Wall of Fire, etc.) leave a 2-round danger zone that NPCs with INT 10+ path around on their own turns. Off by default — adds template rasterisation work; enable on tables with heavy area-control casters.
Settings.MoraleVisibleHint: Show morale gains and losses as floating green (+) / red (−) bubbles above creatures, using the dialogue bubble framework. Off → morale stays hidden in the log.
Settings.MoraleVisibleAudienceHint: Which users see the floating morale bubbles. Each tier includes everyone above it.
Settings.AiTraceEnabled: AI Trace: enable per-turn decision capture
Settings.AiTraceEnabledHint: Records one structured row per NPC turn (archetype, scores, target, movement, action). Zero overhead when off. Access via game.modules.get('5e-npc-combat-automation').api.trace.
Settings.AiTraceAutoLog: AI Trace: also auto-log to console
Settings.AiTraceAutoLogHint: When enabled along with AI Trace, each completed turn is also emitted as a single-line JSON to the dev console. Useful for tailing decisions in real time.
Settings.AiTraceBufferSizeHint: Maximum number of turns held in memory before the oldest are dropped. 500 covers ~50 rounds of a typical encounter. Range 50-5000.
Settings.AiFinishingBlowBiasHint: NPCs aggressively prioritise targets near zero HP. Replaces the linear wounded-target weight with a steep curve — a target at 10% HP gets ~24 bonus, a target at 50% HP gets ~7.5. Disable to revert to the linear preference.
Settings.AiReachabilityPenaltyHint: Penalises target candidates that the NPC cannot reach this turn (even with Dash). Stops melee NPCs from fixating on far-away targets they could not engage. The penalty is overridden by focus-fire, pack tactics, and spellcaster-focus hints, so signature behaviours still take precedence.
Settings.AiCoverAwarePathingHint: Adds a small movement-cost penalty for cells exposed to line-of-sight from ranged enemies. NPCs naturally prefer routes through cover when the cost difference is small, but will still cross open ground when speed matters. Off → behaves identically to v0.10.
Settings.AiScootToCoverHint: After a high-INT ranged NPC (mage, sniper, controller) successfully attacks, it uses leftover movement to step behind cover — breaking the target's line of sight to itself. Self-preserving for the caster and clears the lane for melee allies who would otherwise be blocked. Only fires when INT ≥ 14 and the NPC has a ranged-leaning archetype. Off → behaves identically to v0.12.
Settings.ShowReleaseNotesHint: Show a 'What's New' summary after the module updates to a new version.
Settings.DialogueEnabledHint: Let NPCs speak in-character barks during combat.
Settings.DialogueSpeechBubblesHint: Display floating speech bubbles above speaking tokens on the canvas.
Settings.DialogueMirrorChatHint: Also post spoken lines to the chat log.
Settings.DialogueCombatOnlyHint: Only generate dialogue while an encounter is active.
Settings.DialogueEffortNoisesHint: Include short effort sounds (grunts, cries) alongside spoken lines.
Settings.DialogueTranslateLanguagesHint: Show whether listening players understand the NPC's language, translating only when they do.
Settings.DialogueFrequencyHint: How talkative NPCs are, from 1 (rare) to 10 (constant).
Settings.DialogueJournalNameHint: Name of the journal entry that stores custom per-NPC dialogue lines.
Settings.DialogueBubbleScaleHint: Size multiplier for on-canvas speech bubbles (per-client).
Settings.OpenDialogueJournalHint: Open the journal of custom NPC dialogue lines, creating it if it doesn't exist yet.
Settings.CinematicModeHint: Show a turn 'spotlight' card naming each automated NPC and its intent. 'Subtle' shows the card only; 'Full' also lets the camera follow (see below). Per-client.
Settings.SpotlightCameraHint: When Cinematic Presentation is 'Full', pan the camera to each acting NPC. Off by default — camera movement can be disorienting for players. Per-client.
Settings.CombatDebriefHint: When a combat ends, post a GM recap card summarising automated NPC activity (actions, focus-fire, and — with midi-qol — a damage MVP).
Settings.LegendaryPauseHint: When a boss takes a legendary action, hold the cut-in banner on screen with a 'Continue' button instead of auto-dismissing. Gives off-turn actions (especially legendary movement) time to land and lets the DM intervene before automation proceeds.
Settings.DashPreserveActionHint: Prevents an NPC from spending its action on a Dash when it could already attack from where it stands. A dragon with a ranged spell will cast it rather than dash into melee and lose its whole turn. Bonus-action Dash is unaffected.

UI.ForceAutomate: Force Automate this NPC's turn (bypasses CR limit and automation-off gate)
UI.UndoNPCBlock: Undo NPC Block — restore positions and HP to pre-NPC state
UI.NoArchetypes: No archetypes active — using INT/WIS defaults only.
UI.ArchetypesHint: Check archetypes to manually override the inferred profile. Uncheck all to revert to auto-inference.
UI.CombatConfigHint: Per-NPC overrides. Blank fields fall back to normal AI behaviour and world settings.
UI.PriorityTip: When a visible token with this exact name is a valid target, the NPC always attacks it — skipping target scoring. The no-line-of-sight retry still applies.
UI.BlacklistTip: Comma-separated token names this NPC will never target — as an enemy OR as an ally for heals/buffs.
UI.StartMoraleTip: Seed morale at this value (0–100) when combat starts, instead of the default base. Blank = default.
UI.MoraleImmuneTip: This NPC never loses morale and never routs — fearless regardless of creature type or archetype.
UI.SpellOvTip: Enable per-NPC spell AI overrides below. Off → world settings apply unchanged.
UI.ConsTip: How reluctantly this NPC spends levelled spell slots, overriding the world/archetype setting.
UI.MinAoeTip: Minimum enemies an AOE must catch before this NPC will cast it, overriding the world setting. Blank = world default.

MA.Hint: Manually define this NPC's attack sequence when the automatic parser can't read a complex statblock. When enabled, this overrides parsing.
MA.EnableTip: When on, automation runs the sequence below instead of parsing the Multiattack text.
MA.RetreatTip: This NPC attempts to disengage and fall back once reduced to half HP or below.
MA.EmptySeq: No actions configured. Add from the right.
MA.NoUsable: No usable actions on this actor.

Dialogue.DialogueEnabledHint: NPCs speak contextual combat barks during automation — engagement taunts, damage reactions, kill lines, retreat cries, and death sounds. Fully archetype-driven and anti-spam filtered.
Dialogue.DialogueSpeechBubblesHint: Display a floating speech bubble above the speaking NPC's token. Fades automatically.
Dialogue.DialogueMirrorChatHint: Also post NPC speech to the chat log as an in-character message alongside the speech bubble.
Dialogue.DialogueCombatOnlyHint: When enabled, NPC dialogue barks are restricted to active combat encounters. Disable to allow barks outside of combat.
Dialogue.DialogueEffortNoisesHint: Short attack-effort sounds (Raaah!, Ngh!, *snarl*) separate from the main dialogue. Lower proc chance, no chat mirror.
Dialogue.DialogueTranslateLanguagesHint: When NPC speaks a language not understood by any PC in the scene, display a descriptor (e.g. 'The goblin chatters in Goblin') instead of the actual phrase.
Dialogue.DialogueFrequencyHint: Controls how often chance-based barks trigger. 1 = nearly silent (major events only). 5 = default. 10 = maximum chatter. Guaranteed events (death, morale break, retreat, first engagement) always fire regardless of this setting.
Dialogue.DialogueJournalNameHint: Name of the Journal Entry used for custom NPC dialogue. Each page in that journal should be named after an NPC actor name, actor ID, or a group tag. Create/open it with the button below.
Dialogue.OpenDialogueJournalHint: Opens the NCA Dialogue journal for editing. If it does not exist, a new one is created with a starter template.
Dialogue.DialogueBubbleScaleHint: Adjust the visual size of NPC speech bubbles on your screen. 1.0 is the default. This is a per-client setting — each player can set their own preferred size.

Welcome.Title: Automated NPCs
Welcome.Heading: Welcome to Automated NPCs
Welcome.P1: Automated NPCs runs your monsters for you — tactical movement and pathfinding, spellcasting, morale and retreats, legendary and lair actions, opportunity attacks, and in-character combat dialogue.
Welcome.P2: Start a combat, then press the robot button on the Combat Tracker to hand NPC turns to the module. Every NPC also gets an Automated NPCs tab on its sheet where you can tune its archetype, targeting, and morale.
Welcome.P3: Tip: open the configuration window below to review the defaults. Almost everything can be tuned, and risky features are off by default.
Welcome.NotesFallback: Thanks for updating Automated NPCs. See the changelog for details.

Notes.0_23_0:
• Multiplayer fix: speech bubbles, morale bubbles, and legendary/lair banners now broadcast correctly to every connected player.
  • Cinematic banners for legendary and lair actions are now shared across the table.
  • Keybindings: toggle automation, force-automate the current NPC, and open configuration (unbound by default — set them in Controls).
  • Full localization pass across settings, the NPC sheet tab, dialogs, and notifications.
  • Compatibility metadata corrected for D&D 5e; smoother packaging and updates.
Notes.0_24_0:
• Turn Spotlight. Automated NPCs now announce their turn with a cinematic card naming the creature and what it's doing ("Fanatical Orc unleashes a 3-strike flurry on the bloodied Cleric"). Set intensity per-client in settings — off, card-only, or card + camera.
  • Post-combat debrief. When a fight ends, the GM gets a recap: actions taken, who focused whom, and (with midi-qol) a damage MVP.
  • Intent narration engine drives both, reading the AI's actual decision for each turn.
Notes.0_25_0:
• Multiattack moved into the sheet tab. The manual multiattack editor now lives inside the Automated NPCs tab — no more header button, popup window, or token menu entry. Add, reorder, and set counts inline.
  • Tab no longer vanishes. Fixed the bug where the Automated NPCs tab disappeared when the sheet updated (HP change, edits) and only came back on reopen.
  • Legendary pause (optional). New setting holds the legendary cut-in banner on screen with a 'Continue' button, so off-turn actions — especially legendary movement — have time to land and the DM can intervene before automation proceeds.
Notes.0_25_1:
• Legendary pause now actually pauses. The next NPC's automated turn no longer starts underneath the held banner — legendary interrupts (and the pause) fully resolve before any turn automation begins.
  • Settings duplication fixed. Pause on Legendary Actions, Cinematic Presentation, Spotlight Camera Follow, and Post-Combat Debrief now appear once, in their proper tabs, instead of in both the native panel and the Debug tab.
Notes.0_26_0:
• Depleted features are no longer used. NPCs could keep firing limited-use features and innate spells after their charges ran out on modern D&D 5e. Fixed at every path, with a final check immediately before any action is spent.
  • Speech bubbles follow their token. Bubbles previously tracked only camera movement, so they stayed behind when a token walked.
  • Legendary pause now halts combat. While the banner is held, the turn cannot be advanced at all — it behaves like a player's turn until Continue is clicked.
  • Visual clean-up across the spotlight card and combat debrief.
Notes.1_0_0:
Automated NPCs is now 1.0. Everything in the module is stable, verified at a live table, and ready for regular play.

  • Automated NPC turns: movement and pathfinding, targeting, multiattack, spellcasting, morale and retreats.
  • Boss actions: legendary and lair actions, with an optional pause that holds combat until you are ready.
  • Turn Spotlight cards, combat dialogue, and a post-combat debrief.
  • Per-NPC tuning on every sheet, and a tabbed configuration window for everything else.

Open the configuration window below to review the defaults. Risky features are off by default.
